scientific_integrity: The operator singular representation and asymptotics are analytically proved. Finite numerical checks are supporting evidence only; no independent verification or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Dirichlet exponent 0<alpha<1, integer differentiation order k>=2 and multiplier degree m>=0; radial contraction h down to 0; the critical/diffuse varying-p regimes only. The classical theta identity is not original and independent priority assessment remains necessary.
title: A theta-function spectral-edge transition for monomial Dirichlet composition–differentiation operators
